metadata.syllabus_name: Building Cross-Platform Back-End Application With .NET_Xây dựng ứng dụng back-end với .NET
metadata.time_allocation: Class hours: 22 slot - 1 slot = 135'     Lectures: 10 slots      Tutorials: 12 slotsHome study: 44 slots
metadata.description: Upon completion of this course students shoud: 1. Understand the followings:• Apply C# language for develop ASP.NET WEB API ( RESTful Service applications )  • Fundamental concepts of .NET Core Platform• Basic knowledge of  ASP.NET WEB API on .NET Core• Basic knowledge of  RESTful Service and Microservice architecture2. Be able to:• Develop Cross - platform Back-end application can be used by  Desktop or Web applications (Cross - platform)• Develop RESTful Service applications by ASP.NET Web API  and Windows Communication Foundation (WCF)  • Implement  security in the ASP.NET WEB API• Implement sending Ajax request to  ASP.NET WEB API • Implement security  JWT  in ASP.NET Core Web API• Develop Distributed applications based on Microservice architecture3. Be able to work in team and present group's results
metadata.student_tasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact sessions in order to be accepted to the final examination.- Student is responsible to do all assigned exercises given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time- Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly  access to the FU CMS at http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information
metadata.tools: - Internet- Visual Studio.NET 2019 version 16.8.3 or later - Platform : .NET 5.0 or later

clos.lo_details: Describe about .NET Core Platform, and ASP.NET WEB API Architecture
Demonstrate Models, ODATA, Entity Framework Core ,and Media Formatters & Content Negotiation
Demonstrate about implementing security in RESTful WebService
Demonstrate about JavaScript Client and sending AJAX Requests to ASP.NET Web API
Demonstrate about implementing RESTful Services by WCF, gRPC Services and introduction about Microservices architecture.
